description: This file contains utility functions related to access control, field rendering, email settings, and template parsing for the SuiteCRM platform. It handles dynamic form generation, configuration retrieval, and template processing within the CRM system.

classes.name: EmailTemplates
classes.description: Class responsible for email template parsing and rendering.

classes.name: BeanFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and retrieving CRM bean objects.

methods.name: getAOPAssignField
methods.description: Generates HTML select fields for assigning roles, security groups, or roles with dynamic visibility based on existing files.

methods.name: getAOPAssignFieldDetailView
methods.description: Creates a human-readable string representation of assignment fields for display in views.

methods.name: isAOPEnabled
methods.description: Checks system configuration to determine if AOP (Advocacy or Access Control) is enabled.

methods.name: getPortalEmailSettings
methods.description: Retrieves email configuration settings, falling back to admin settings if custom ones are unavailable.

methods.name: aop_parse_template
methods.description: Parses email templates, replacing variable placeholders with bean data, with support for custom field types.
